# Proof & Realness

Legend: [D] demonstrated · [A] anticipated · [T] target.

- [A] "Radio is live" - treated as the most direct proof ("the radio station just being on is evidence of it being real"), but within the transcript it is a future launch, not yet shown; unverified.
- [T] "42 seats keep getting filled" - ongoing fill rate of assembly seats.
- [A] The tour "signing up people": "this conference has been visited... this location has been onboarded," producing "the list of dates" and "a person there now... ready to keep get involved."
- [A] Universities and "42 locations" onboarded as the tour proceeds.
- [T] "Marvin proliferation" - but qualified: "I don't see that Marvin has been built by then." Instead an "artistic story about Marvin and a representation and a demo," plus "teasing" a "November" token sale with "dynamic equity." Asserted, not shown; unverified within the transcript.

**Headline metric.** Whether "the radio is live" and stays on, with "42 seats keep getting filled" as the companion count the group actually watches.
